messages:
jess: quick q for the auto-fallback page: two inputs (p95 and error%) or one simple slider?
ryan: two. latency and error spikes are different signals.
priya: two + presets (conservative/balanced/aggressive). advanced collapsed.
jess: ok default hosted guesses: p95=400ms, error=1%. open to tweaks.
ryan: add per-route presets (chat vs embed). also list which errors count (5xx, timeout, model_reject).
priya: preview idea: estimated switch % from last 24-72h sampled telemetry. show matched/total.
ops-bot: warning: full scans are expensive. recommend default preview sample_pct=5% and capped window.
nina: audit defaults: canary=10% capture, auto-fallback=1%. show cost estimate badge.
ryan: capture payload toggle default off for hosted, privacy badge if on.
jess: operator overrides require reason+optional TTL and create an audit entry. show undo for 5m.
priya: oscillation protection: min_switch_interval and exponential backoff. default min_switch_interval=5m.
ryan: rule authoring: small boolean builder (status==500 OR contains(msg,"OOM") OR latency>1000) with live sample matches.
ops-bot: note: expression evaluation must be sandboxed and access to replay API audited.
jess: i'll sketch a compact mock: two inputs + presets, advanced rule builder, preview pane with sampled stats, hysteresis controls, audit toggles, override timeline. posting tomorrow.
